facts.text: Everybody eat, then we check out that transmission. Company orders, nobody likes them.
facts.why: Dallas has no such line on the quote page, and no line about eating or the transmission. The Company order is Ash's 'Bring back lifeform: Priority One.' Printed in quote marks and signed Dallas.
facts.fix: Eat first. Transmission check after. Company orders are Company orders. Dallas (set as a written note, no quote marks)

facts.text: Brett's answer to every round. Right.
facts.why: Parker tells Brett that whenever Parker says anything Brett just says 'Right', so the joke on Brett's answer holds.
